title: Hoshino Ichika — Unformed Feelings〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think the second verse went something like this... Wait, this part... Is this what it sounded like...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... Something isn't right here...
<Ichika.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku! What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You said during practice yesterday that you were going to be trying something. I came to see what you were talking about.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <How is it going? Good?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... Not really...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I'm trying to remember how to play the song I wrote for Saki and the others during that dream.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, the one you had “me” sing...?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Saki and the others said that it was really good, so I was hoping to sing it as a Leo/need song for real.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wonderful. I've been meaning to ask you more about that song.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But if you haven't made much progress, then...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can't clearly recall how the melody went or what the lyrics were. I'm only able to remember bits and pieces...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Can you play for me what you have been able to remember? I'd also like to see the lyrics if possible...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sure, I'll play the melody now.
And the lyrics are here in this notebook.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, I see...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
This is a part of the chorus...
But it's pretty hard to tell what the song is about, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I don't think so.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I sensed your kindness very clearly, Ichika. You were trying to show your support for Saki and the others.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The lyrics also made me want to keep my chin up and move forward.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But the melody and lyrics still feel really incomplete. This song is different from the one I had the others listen to in that dream.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Why can't I remember how it went? I can clearly recall everything else that happened.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Do you remember what you felt as you wrote this song...?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, actually...
I remember the theme being a song of support that would cheer them up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hmm... What if you can't remember because of that massive sense of relief you felt after getting your message across to them?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that might be why.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: After they said that it was good, I felt this incredible sense of accomplishment or fulfillment.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we began talking about performing as a band at the school festival, watched the Leonid meteor shower together and finally got our memories back...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Considering how quickly things moved at the end there, I think it's only natural that you don't remember how your song went.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I tried thinking about the emotions I felt, and even tried to revive them. But nothing's worked so far.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You really can't do anything about that.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Because the you from that dream and the real you are one and the same, but also not.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I mean, when writing a song, an individual's experiences and knowledge can greatly influence what they end up producing, no?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
Compared to my current self, the me in that dream led a drastically different life.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Exactly...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Only the you from that dream was capable of producing that song.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that dream, not only was I terrible at playing the guitar, that was the first song I'd ever written. I was really just wandering around in the dark.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If I were to hear that song right now, I might feel embarrassed because of how bad I was at everything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I managed to reach the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Which sort of makes me believe that it may be better for you not to remember how it went.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You could all lock it away in your hearts as the fabled song that brought you back together.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Fabled...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Trying to recreate it based on just bits and pieces of information wouldn't be very fair to the me from that dream.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Instead, I should be writing songs that I can produce as I am now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I agree with that statement.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'll be looking forward to hearing your new song. I'd like to sing it if possible.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course! All of us can sing it, together!
